page.notes: Layout: one column of running text. Two margin notes on the left, marked a and b, placed where their reference marks stand in the text. Doubtful readings: "praesumpt." in note a; the note b reference "Controu.§. ld.9.cap.14." is uncertain (the "§" and "ld" are hard to read); "impertitimus" at the line end of the gloss is doubtful; "deducta"/"deductum fit" is doubtful. Italics: the italic runs were judged from the scan and may be slightly off at their edges, especially around "Negat" and "nam nos neutros". Paragraph breaks: the page appears to run as one paragraph after the opening; the break points inside the long gloss section are uncertain.
